description: Send an arbitrary GraphQL query (with optional variables) directly to the STRATZ API at api.stratz.com/graphql. Use when no named tool covers the data you need. Field names are camelCase and must match the STRATZ schema exactly (e.g. numLastHits, goldPerMinute, constants { gameModes }); a query naming an unknown field fails with "Cannot query field", so introspect the type (`{ __type(name: "MatchPlayerType") { fields { name } } }`) before guessing. Requires a STRATZ Bearer token.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

name: graphql
